paragraphs: Scorpio Tankers Inc. was incorporated in the Republic of the Marshall Islands pursuant to the BCA on July 1, 2009. We provide seaborne transportation of crude oil and refined petroleum products worldwide. We began our operations in October 2009 with three vessels. In April 2010, we completed our initial public offering, and our common stock commenced trading on the New York Stock Exchange, or NYSE, under the symbol "STNG." We have since expanded, and as of March 19, 2026, our fleet consisted of 90 wholly owned tankers (34 LR2, 42 MR and 14 Handymax) with a weighted average age of approximately 10.1 years.

Our principal executive offices are located at 99 Boulevard du Jardin Exotique, Monaco, 98000 and our telephone number at that address is +377-9798-5716. The SEC maintains an Internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC. The address of the SEC's Internet site is http://www.sec.gov. The address of the Company's Internet site is http://www.scorpiotankers.com. None of the information contained on these websites is incorporated into or forms a part of this annual report.

For information regarding our fleet please see "Item 5. Operating and Financial Review and Prospects-B. Liquidity and Capital Resources-Capital Expenditures-Vessel acquisitions and payments for vessels under construction."
In March 2026, we commenced a time charter-out agreement on an LR2 product tanker, STI Lombard, for five years at a rate of $33,000 per day.

In March 2026, we entered into a time charter-out agreement on an LR2 product tanker, STI Rambla, for eight years at a rate of $30,500 per day. This charter is expected to commence in the first or second quarter of 2026.
On February 11, 2026, our Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.45 per common share, which is payable on March 20, 2026 to all shareholders of record as of March 6, 2026.
In January 2026, we closed on the sale of the 2019 built scrubber-fitted LR2 product tanker, STI Lavender, for $61.2 million.
In February 2026, we closed on the sales of the 2016 built scrubber-fitted LR2 product tankers, STI Goal and STI Gallantry, for $52.3 million per vessel.

In March 2026, we entered into agreements to sell two 2015 built scrubber-fitted MR product tankers, STI Seneca and STI Osceola for $35.0 million per vessel and a 2015 built scrubber-fitted LR2 product tanker, STI Solidarity, for $60.0 million. These sales are expected to close within the first or second quarter of 2026. In March 2026, these three vessels, STI Seneca, STI Osceola and STI Solidarity, were released from collateral on the 2023 $1.0 Billion Credit Facility and we paid the outstanding debt balance of $20.2 million related to these vessels and reduced the amount available under the revolving portion of the facility by $10.8 million.

In January 2026, STI Kingsway was released from collateral on the 2023 $1.0 Billion Credit Facility, with no outstanding balance and reducing the amount available under the revolving portion of the facility by $13.7 million. We entered into an agreement to sell this vessel for $57.5 million in December 2025 with closing expected in the first quarter of 2026.

In February 2026, we paid the $18.9 million purchase option, representing the aggregate outstanding lease obligation, on the LR2 product tanker, STI Symphony, that was financed under the Ocean Yield Lease Financing arrangement and thus terminated the lease.

In February 2026, we declared options to purchase two scrubber-fitted LR2 newbuilding product tankers that are to be constructed at Dalian Shipbuilding Industry Co., Ltd. in China for $68.5 million per vessel. Deliveries are expected in the third and fourth quarters of 2029.

The recent military conflict in Iran has had a significant direct and indirect impact on the trade of crude oil and refined petroleum products. The conflict has disrupted major trading routes such as the Strait of Hormuz and as a result, the price of oil and petroleum products has risen significantly. We cannot predict what effect the higher price of oil and petroleum products will have on demand, and it is possible that the current conflict in Iran could adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, financial position, and future performance.

We provide seaborne transportation of refined petroleum products worldwide. As of March 19, 2026, our fleet consisted of 90 wholly owned product tankers (34 LR2, 42 MR and 14 Handymax) with a weighted average age of approximately 10.1 years, which we refer to collectively as our Operating Fleet.

headings: The tanker industry is cyclical and volatile, which may adversely affect our earnings and available cash flow.
We are dependent on spot-oriented pools and spot charters and any decrease in spot charter rates in the future may adversely affect our earnings.
An over-supply of tanker capacity may depress charter rates, which may limit our ability to operate our tankers profitably.
Changes in fuel, or bunkers, prices may adversely affect our profits.
Tanker rates also fluctuate based on seasonal variations in demand.
A shift in consumer demand from oil towards other energy sources or changes to trade patterns for refined oil products may have a material adverse effect on our business.
Volatility in economic conditions throughout the world could have an adverse impact on our results of operations and financial condition.
Increased trade tensions between the U.S. and China could have a material adverse effect on our operations and financial results.
Developments in safety and environmental requirements relating to the recycling of vessels may result in escalated and unexpected costs.
We operate tankers worldwide, and as a result, we are exposed to inherent operational and international risks, which may adversely affect our business and financial condition.
Increased inspection procedures could increase costs and disrupt our business.
Acts of piracy and other attacks on ocean-going vessels could adversely affect our business.

The occurrence of any of the events described in this section could significantly and negatively affect our business, financial condition, operating results or cash available for the payment of dividends on our common shares and interest on our debt securities, or the trading price of our securities.

•the current and future supply to tanker capacity and its impact on charter rates applicable to us;

paragraphs: The following presentation of management's discussion and analysis of results of operations and financial condition should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements, accompanying notes thereto and other financial information appearing in "Item 18. Financial Statements." You should also carefully read the following discussion with the sections of this annual report entitled "Item 3. Key Information—D. Risk Factors," "Item 4. Information on the Company—B. Business Overview—The International Oil Tanker Shipping Industry," and "Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements." Our consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 2025 and 2024 and for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023 have been prepared in accordance with IFRS as issued by the IASB. Our consolidated financial statements are presented in U.S. dollars ($) unless otherwise indicated. Any amounts converted from another non-U.S. currency to U.S. dollars in this annual report are at the rate applicable at the relevant date, or the average rate during the applicable period.

We generate revenues by charging customers for the transportation of their refined oil and other petroleum products using our vessels. These services are generally provided under the following basic types of contractual relationships:
•Voyage charters, which are charters for short intervals that are priced on current, or "spot," market rates.

•Time or bareboat charters, which are vessels chartered to customers for a fixed period of time at rates that are generally fixed, but may contain a variable component based on inflation, interest rates, or current market rates.

•Commercial Pools, whereby we participate with other shipowners to operate a large number of vessels as an integrated transportation system, which offers customers greater flexibility and a higher level of service while achieving scheduling efficiencies. Pools negotiate charters primarily in the spot market but may also arrange time charter agreements. The size and scope of these pools enable them to enhance utilization rates for pool vessels by securing backhaul voyages and COAs (described below), thus generating higher effective TCE revenues than otherwise might be obtainable in the spot market.

With the exception of vessels that are bareboat chartered out, we are responsible for crewing and other vessel operating costs for our owned, lease financed, or bareboat chartered-in vessels and the charterhire expense for vessels that we time or bareboat charter-in.

paragraphs: Scorpio Tankers Inc. 設立於馬紹爾羣島共和國，依據BCA於2009年7月1日成立。我們提供全球範圍內原油與精煉石油產品的海上運輸服務。我們於2009年10月開始營運，當時擁有三艘船舶。2010年4月，我們完成首次公開發行，本公司普通股開始在紐約證券交易所，或簡稱NYSE，以符號"STNG"進行交易。我們隨後持續擴張，截至2026年3月19日，本公司船隊共擁有90艘完全擁有之油輪（34艘LR2、42艘MR及14艘Handymax），平均使用年齡約為10.1年。

本公司主要營業據點位於Monaco的99 Boulevard du Jardin Exotique，郵遞區號98000，該地址之電話號碼為+377-9798-5716。美國證券交易委員會（SEC）維護一個網際網路網站，提供發行人電子提交之報告、股東權利說明書及資訊聲明等資料。SEC網站網址為http://www.sec.gov。本公司網站網址為http://www.scorpiotankers.com。這些網站上所載之資訊並未納入或成為本年度報告之一部分。
有關本公司船隊之資訊，請參閱"項目5.營運與財務審閱及展望-B.流動性與資本運用-資本支出-船舶購買新船及正在建造船舶之付款"。
2026年3月，本公司開始與一艘LR2產品油輪STI Lombard簽訂期租合約，租賃期限為五年，每日租金為33,000美元。
2026年3月，本公司與一艘LR2產品油輪STI Rambla簽訂期租合約，租賃期限為八年，每日租金為30,500美元。此租賃預計於2026年第一或第二季開始。
2026年2月11日，本公司董事會宣佈發放每股0.45美元之季度現金股息，該股息於2026年3月20日支付予2026年3月6日登記為股東之所有股東。
2026年1月，本公司完成出售於2019年建造、配備除硫裝置之LR2產品油輪STI Lavender，售價為61.2百萬美元。
2026年2月，本公司完成出售於2016年建造、配備除硫裝置之LR2產品油輪STI Goal及STI Gallantry，每艘售價為52.3百萬美元。

2026 年 3 月，本公司與買方簽訂協議，出售兩艘 2015 年建造、裝備 Scrubber 的 MR 產品油輪 STI Seneca 與 STI Osceola，每艘售價為 35.0 百萬美元，以及一艘 2015 年建造、裝備 Scrubber 的 LR2 產品油輪 STI Solidarity，售價為 60.0 百萬美元。這些交易預計於 2026 年第一或第二季完成。2026 年 3 月，STI Seneca、STI Osceola 與 STI Solidarity 這三艘船舶已從 2023 年 1.0 十億美元信用融資安排的擔保中解脫，本公司並償還與這些船舶相關的未償還債務餘額 20.2 百萬美元，同時將信用融資安排中循環部分的可用金額減少 10.8 百萬美元。
2026 年 1 月，STI Kingsway 從 2023 年 1.0 十億美元信用融資安排的擔保中解脫，且無未償還餘額，同時將信用融資安排中循環部分的可用金額減少 13.7 百萬美元。本公司於 2025 年 12 月與買方簽訂協議，出售此船舶，售價為 57.5 百萬美元，預計於 2026 年第一季完成交易。
2026 年 2 月，本公司支付 18.9 百萬美元的購船選擇權，代表 LR2 產品油輪 STI Symphony 的總未償還租賃義務，該船舶係透過 Ocean Yield 租賃融資安排融資，因此終止租賃契約。
2026 年 2 月，本公司宣佈選擇購買兩艘裝備 Scrubber 的 LR2 新造產品油輪，將於中國大連船舶重工有限公司建造，每艘售價為 68.5 百萬美元。預計於 2029 年第三及第四季交付。
伊朗最近的軍事衝突對原油與煉製石油產品的貿易產生顯著的直接與間接影響。衝突已幹擾主要貿易航線，例如霍爾木茲 Strait，因此油價與石油產品價格大幅上漲。本公司無法預測油價與石油產品價格上漲對需求的影響，且目前伊朗的衝突可能對本公司財務狀況、營運成果、現金流、財務狀況與未來表現產生不利影響。
本公司提供全球範圍內的海上煉製石油產品運輸服務。截至 2026 年 3 月 19 日，本公司船隊共計擁有 90 艘全資擁有產品油輪（34 艘 LR2、42 艘 MR 與 14 艘 Handymax），加權平均船齡約為 10.1 年，本公司將這些船舶 collectively 稱為運營船隊。

paragraphs: 下列有關管理層對營運結果及財務狀況之分析與討論，應配合本公司合併財務報表、相關附註及其他財務資訊一併閱讀，該財務資訊載於「第 18 項 財務報表」。您亦應謹慎閱讀下列討論，並與本年度報告中標題為「第 3 項 關鍵資訊—D. 風險因素」、「第 4 項 關於本公司之資訊—B. 事業概覽—國際油輪運輸業」及「警示有關未來展望陳述」之部分一併閱讀。本公司於 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日之合併財務報表，以及 2025 年、2024 年及 2023 年截至 12 月 31 日為止之年度財務報表，係依國際會計準則（IFRS）由國際會計準則理事會（IASB）所頒佈。本公司合併財務報表以美國美元（$）為計價單位，除非另有說明。本年度報告中，任何由其他非美國貨幣換算為美國美元之金額，係以該金額所屬日期之匯率，或該期間內之平均匯率為準。
本公司透過向客戶收取費用，以提供其精煉油及其他石油產品之運輸服務來產生營業收入。這些服務通常透過以下基本類型之契約關係提供：
• 航次租賃（Voyage charters），為短暫期間之租賃，價格依現行市場（或稱「現貨」）利率訂定。
• 時期租賃或光船租賃（Time or bareboat charters），為將船舶租賃給客戶一段固定期間，租金通常為固定金額，但可能包含根據通貨膨脹、利率或現行市場利率而變動之零組件。
• 商業池（Commercial Pools），本公司與其他船舶所有者合作，以整合運輸系統方式運營大量船舶，為客戶提供更高的靈活性及服務水準，同時實現排程效率。池會主要在現貨市場洽談租賃，但亦可能安排時期租賃契約。這些池的規模與範圍使其能透過取得回程航程及 COA（如下所述）來提高池船舶之使用率，從而產生高於現貨市場所能取得之有效 TCE 收入。
除光船租賃出之船舶外，本公司對本公司所有、租賃融資或光船租賃進之船舶之船員及其它船舶運營費用負有責任，並對本公司時期租賃或光船租賃進之船舶之租賃費用負有責任。

headings: 油輪產業具有週期性與不穩定性，可能對我們的獲利與可用現金流產生不利影響。
我們依賴於以現貨為導向的船隊與現貨租賃，未來若現貨租賃率下降，可能對我們的獲利產生不利影響。
油輪運力過度供給可能壓低租賃率，可能限制我們以獲利方式運作油輪的能力。
燃料價格或 bunkers 價格的變動可能對我們的利潤產生不利影響。
油輪租賃率也會因季節性需求變動而波動。
消費者對石油需求向其他能源來源轉移，或精煉石油產品貿易模式的變動，可能對我們的業務產生重大不利影響。
全球經濟條件的波動可能對我們的營運成果與財務狀況產生不利影響。
美國與中國之間的貿易緊張關係升溫，可能對本公司的營運及財務結果造成重大不利影響。
有關船舶回收的安全部分及環境要求的發展，可能導致成本增加且出現未預期的費用。
本公司在全球運營油輪，因此面臨內在的營運及國際風險，這些風險可能對本公司業務及財務狀況造成不利影響。
檢查程序增加可能導致成本上升並幹擾本公司業務。
對海上船舶的盜賊行為及其他攻擊事件可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
paragraphs: 下列風險主要與我們所從事的產業及一般業務有關。其他風險則主要與證券市場及持有我們證券的投資人相關。本節所描述的任何事件發生，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果或用以支付普通股股息及債務證券利息的現金，以及我們證券的交易價格產生顯著且負面的影響。
